label: Poor — Significant Gaps

issues.title: AWS Access Key ID
issues.impact: Immediate AWS account compromise. Attackers can spin up compute, exfiltrate S3 data, or rack up massive bills.
issues.remediation: 1. Revoke key immediately in AWS IAM Console. 2. Run: git filter-repo --invert-paths --path src/config/aws.js to remove from history. 3. Use IAM Roles or AWS Secrets Manager instead.

issues.title: .env file present in repository
issues.impact: Environment files often contain production credentials. Committing them exposes all configured secrets.
issues.remediation: 1. Add ".env" to .gitignore immediately. 2. Run: git rm --cached .env && git commit. 3. Rotate ALL credentials in the file. 4. Create .env.example with placeholder values.

issues.title: No SECURITY.md — missing vulnerability disclosure policy
issues.impact: Security researchers have no sanctioned channel to report vulnerabilities.
issues.remediation: Create .github/SECURITY.md with your vulnerability reporting process.

issues.title: Critical path untested: Authentication/Authorization (src/middleware/auth.ts)
issues.impact: Authentication middleware has no test coverage. A regression here could allow unauthorized access to protected routes.
issues.remediation: Create src/middleware/auth.test.ts covering valid token, expired token, missing token, and malformed token scenarios.
suggested_test_cases: should allow requests with valid JWT
should reject requests with expired JWT
should reject requests with no Authorization header
should reject requests with malformed token

issues.title: Critical path untested: Payment/Billing (src/services/payment.ts)
issues.impact: Payment logic has zero test coverage. A silent regression could cause failed transactions or double charges.
issues.remediation: Create src/services/payment.test.ts. Mock Stripe API calls. Test success flow, failure handling, and webhook verification.
suggested_test_cases: should handle valid payment intent creation
should handle Stripe API failure gracefully
should verify webhook signature before processing
should handle idempotency for duplicate requests

issues.title: No lockfile found (package-lock.json / yarn.lock)
issues.impact: Without a lockfile, npm install resolves to the latest compatible versions. A dependency update can silently break production.
issues.remediation: Run: npm install (generates package-lock.json). Commit the lockfile and never add it to .gitignore.

issues.title: jsonwebtoken@8.5.1 — Algorithm confusion / header injection
issues.impact: Algorithm confusion attacks allow forging of JWTs in older versions of jsonwebtoken.

issues.title: README missing: Configuration guide
issues.impact: Missing configuration section forces users to read source code to configure the app.
issues.remediation: Add a '## Configuration' section to README.md documenting all environment variables.

issues.title: Missing CONTRIBUTING.md
issues.impact: Without contributing guidelines, contributors guess at PR process, branch naming, and code standards.
issues.remediation: Add CONTRIBUTING.md describing how to set up the dev environment, branch naming conventions, and PR process.

issues.title: JSDoc coverage critically low (18% of 34 exports)
issues.impact: Functions without documentation are black boxes. Increases onboarding time and bug risk.
issues.remediation: Add JSDoc comments to all exported functions. Start with the public API surface.

issues.title: No CI/CD configuration found
issues.impact: Code ships without automated testing, linting, or security checks.
issues.remediation: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs npm test and npm run lint on every push and pull request.

issues.title: Missing LICENSE file
issues.impact: Without a license, the code is legally All Rights Reserved. Nobody can legally use or contribute to it.
issues.remediation: Add a LICENSE file. Use https://choosealicense.com to pick the right license for your project.

issues.title: No coverage reporting configured
issues.impact: Without coverage metrics you have no visibility into which code is exercised by tests.
issues.remediation: Add --coverage flag to your test script, or configure c8 as a coverage reporter.

issues.title: Dependabot not configured
issues.impact: Without automated dependency updates, vulnerable packages will silently accumulate.
issues.remediation: Create .github/dependabot.yml with npm ecosystem configured for weekly updates.

recommendations: Address all high-severity security findings immediately — rotate any exposed credentials before anything else
Add tests for authentication and payment flows — these are your highest-risk untested paths
Complete the README with installation, usage, and configuration sections
Run npm install to generate a lockfile and commit it
Update jsonwebtoken to latest version to patch CVE-2022-23529
Configure Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) to receive automated weekly dependency update PRs
Add SECURITY.md to define your vulnerability disclosure process
